chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Mahbub, from al-Ahwal, from Sallam ibn al-Mustanir, from Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام concerning His, the Exalted, saying:
Say: This is my way; I call to Allah with insight, I and those who follow me.
He said: That is Rasul Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام, and the successors from after them.

key_terms.أَدْعُو: I call; the summons toward Allah
key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the Commander of the Faithful, Imam Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.الْأَوْصِيَاءُ: the successors or designated legatees after the Messenger and Amir al-Mu'minin
key_terms.بَصِيرَةٍ: insight; clear knowledge and sure guidance
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.سَبِيلِي: my way; the divinely appointed path being identified in the verse

ai.seo_question: Who are the ones described as calling to Allah with insight in Qur'an 12:108?
ai.summary: This narration explains the verse as referring not only to Rasul Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, but also to Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام and the awsiya' after them. It presents the call to Allah upon insight as a continuing divinely guided path associated with wilayah and succession.
